formulas.contact_validation: recompute touch-threshold contact GRF checks over every contact CSV row
formulas.dynamics_validation: forward-difference subtree velocity and compare total contact GRF to m*(a-g), p95 discrete index
formulas.flag_counts: raw value counts in all, stage-2, and requested-cycle CSV windows
formulas.health_metrics: max absolute or min of controller.log Trot cycle N health fields for N in 1..64
formulas.progress_speed: ordinary least-squares slope of world_base_x_m versus state_tick_s
